name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.4 degrees south of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 9 times in 3 visits over 31 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 18 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 31 hours starting 2026-07-18, at wavelengths from 0.74 to 3.42 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
